name: Facet
text: Choose a **full-height left sidebar** for primary navigation and context. It keeps the main view uncluttered while giving users instant access to tools and data layers—critical for speed and clarity. Trade-off: it shrinks the main canvas, but the trade-off is worth it because navigation and context are more important than maximizing screen space.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A full-height left sidebar buries critical updates under layers of scroll—users won’t notice urgent changes until they hunt for them. A thin top strip for alerts drowns users in noise, but a collapsible sidebar still hides updates in the collapsed state. Settle it: test both with a live prototype showing a simulated alert—if users miss the update in either, that’s the loser.
